name: structMap
description:
Calls the given closure with every element in the given struct.
the function returns a struct that contains all values returned by the closure.
syntax: structMap( struct struct, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
filter can be a function/closure that implements the following constructor

[function(string key, any value[, struct struct]):any].

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
